chapter: Memphis, Oklahoma, the Kirk band and Kansas City
title: John joins the band; Jimmy Lunceford fills in for him in Memphis
summary: The Williams combo was doing well at the White Rose when John left to join a band; Lunceford replaced him for six months while she finished dates. She also relates the band's meeting about T. Holder.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: You worked there for about a year?

Well, just about 6 months or so because/She I had to leave - wouldn't trust me - I mean wouldn't... because of conditions that existed like that in Tennessee. So what happened, John got this terrific combo going out at the White Rose or something like that. in Memphis. We were just doing real great and all of a sudden wo decided to join Andy Kirk's band. So I had to get someone to play with me to take his place so I hired Jimmy Lunceford. He worked /with me for about 6 months and this was while we were in Memphis.
Jimmy didn't have his band. It wasn't organized. He didn't organize it until maybe about 6 months or a year after I left Memphis.
It wasn't Andy Kirk that John was going to join?
It seemed that was kind of a reckless guy with money and he'd done this so many times so that the entire band called a meeting and they decided to have Andy as the leader of the band...
This happened after you had joined?
After I had joined. Jimmy Lunceford worked for me for about, I guess, 6 months, I don't know how long it was...
Why did you stay that long in Memphis after John left?

Because he had built up such a big clientele with all the gigs and jobs and things that he had worked for - I guess we were there 2 or 3 years. They still wanted some parts of the band - he was missing and I was a big part of it, being so tiny and whatnot, and then we had some dates that we had to play. We had to finish these dates. We got some more dates then to play.
